title: Pharmacy public availability feed (future, read-only)
description: NOT USED BY VERSION 1. Contract for a file or API response the pharmacy program could publish later (F28 website, patient availability portal). Each item says only whether a public item is available. Never quantities, prices, batches, expiry dates, suppliers, costs, customers, patients or prescriptions. See docs/INTEGRATION.md.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. Bump on any breaking change.

generated_at.description: When the program produced the feed (UTC, ISO 8601). Lets the site show how fresh it is and hide a stale feed.

name.description: Public display name chosen for publishing (not an internal code or barcode).

category.description: Public category from a short fixed list the owner approves.

available.description: true = in stock now, false = not in stock. Never a number.
